gen-tourney-gf-inter-tight: Tourney stretches its uniform strokes out wide, with bulky little lowercase letters that feel built for the track. Inter Tight follows in a plain sans, compact and smooth, easy going over long paragraphs.
gen-tourney-gf-karla: Stocky and friendly, Karla sets a tall middle band and a gaping c opening beneath Tourney's wide-tracked, single-width strokes. Their strongest quality is a loud-meets-easygoing contrast.
gen-tourney-gf-kedebideri: Loud, stretched, sporty letters up top. Kedebideri sits beneath with a skyward x-height and rounded shapes, giving Tourney's heavy uniform strokes a friendly counterweight on the page.
gen-tourney-gf-khula: Khula reads smoothly, its tall midsection and open-mouthed curves making each line feel generous and modern. Tourney's marker-like, wide-set heading sits above it and gives the page a sporty headline voice.
gen-tourney-gf-krub: Wide, chunky and athletic. Tourney's single-width strokes sit above Krub, whose pronounced x-height and unfinished curves keep the sans-serif text light and contemporary.
gen-tourney-gf-kufam: Tourney spreads out in bulky, wide-tracked letters, every stroke cut to a single width. Kufam answers in a similar tube-like line, but its open e curves and dominant lowercase feel softer beneath the heading.
gen-tourney-gf-lexend: Lexend reads open and approachable, its oversized lowercase and gaping curves easy on the eye. Its strongest pairing quality is how Tourney's wide, uniform athletic shout gets a friendly, steady companion.
gen-tourney-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca reads plainly, with an unshaded line and big lowercase beside small-looking capitals. What stands out is how Tourney's chunky, stretched heading gives that quiet sans a confident, sporty lead.
gen-tourney-gf-liter: Liter brings a stroke with no contrast at all and lowercase with real vertical presence, wide-mouthed on every round form. Tourney's stretched, athletic heading makes the strongest quality here a bold, modern punch.
gen-tourney-gf-mada: Drawn as if with one wide pen tip, Tourney stretches out bold and bulky across the top. Mada follows with curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone, giving the pair an approachable, plain sans counterweight.
